spells.transcript_notes: Spell predates the transcript coverage (2000-06 to 2025-01), so no check applies.
spells.notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25 (caretaker holdover). Announced in the 2·18 개각 of 1985 on the afternoon of 1985-02-18 (the 대통령기록관 schedule and the 대한민국사연표 date the reshuffle 1985-02-18). The new cabinet received the 임명장 on the morning of 1985-02-19 and his 이취임식 with 김정례 was held at 14:00 that day (조선일보 1985-02-20, 동아일보 1985-02-19 p.10), so the start is the 임명장 day, which is also the MOHW date. The whole 5공 cabinet handed in blanket resignations after the last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24 and 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25, then appointed the new cabinet, which included his successor 권이혁 (조선일보 1988-02-26, 매일경제 1988-02-25, 중앙일보 1988-02-25). He was not reappointed, so end_reason is replaced and the end is the handover day. MOHW prints 1988-02-24 as his last day (day-before convention) and ko.wikipedia 1988-02-25. Gender from the 1985-02-19 profiles, which name his wife. Birth date from the MOHW 약력 (solar). Later 서울특별시장 (MOHW 약력, not used for dates). No gazette files exist before 2001.

spells.notes: Named by 대통령당선인 노태우 on 1988-02-19 as one of the new ministers of the first 6공 cabinet (동아일보 and 중앙일보 1988-02-19). The new President gave the 임명장 to the PM 서리 and the new 국무위원 on the morning of 1988-02-25, right after his inauguration and after accepting the 5공 cabinet's blanket resignations. Former 문교부장관 and 한국교원대학교 총장. Replaced in the 12·5 전면개각 of 1988. That morning all 국무위원 handed their resignations to the President at an 임시국무회의, and the new ministers received the 임명장 the same day (경향신문 1988-12-05, 한겨레 1988-12-06). MOHW prints 1988-12-04 as the last day (day-before convention). Birth year only because the MOHW 약력 gives a lunar date (1923/07/13 음력). Gender from the 1988-02-19/20 profiles, which name his wife. Later 환경처장관 1991-1992 (environment lineage, MOHW 약력). No gazette files exist before 2001.

End is that same-day handover. MOHW prints 1989-07-18 (day-before convention). Gender from the 1988-12-05 profiles, which name his wife. Birth date from the MOHW 약력 (solar).

spells.notes: Named and appointed on 1989-07-19 in the 7·19 개각 (임명장 at 11:00). Left to become 대통령비서실 경제수석비서관 (장관급) in the 3·17 개각 of 1990, announced on 1990-03-17 (동아일보 1990-03-17, 한국일보 1990-03-18), so end_reason is other (moved to a presidential secretariat post). The cabinet had handed in blanket resignations at an 임시국무회의 on 1990-03-16 (세계일보 1990-03-17). His successor and the new 청와대 비서진 received the 임명장 on the morning of 1990-03-19 (국민일보 1990-03-19). No separate date for his own 면직 was found, so the end is the successor's start. MOHW prints 1990-03-18 (day-before convention) and ko.wikipedia 1990-03-19. Birth date and gender from the MOHW 약력 (solar) and na_members_12_22.csv (1940-07-11, 남). spells.notes: Named on the afternoon of 1991-05-26 on the recommendation of the new PM 서리 정원식, 임명장 on the morning of 1991-05-27 (동아일보 1991-05-27, 경향신문 1991-05-28). Retired 육군대장 (육사 12기), former 대한석탄공사 사장 and 주택은행 이사장. Kept on in the 10·9 개각 of 1992 (the 중립내각), when the resignations of the retained ministers were returned (서울신문 1992-10-10, 한국일보 1992-10-10). Still in office when 김영삼 took office on 1993-02-25. The 총무처 view reported on 1993-02-24 was that sitting ministers had no fixed term, did not need to resign and would hand over when the new President appointed successors (매일경제 1993-02-24). The first 김영삼 cabinet was announced on the morning of 1993-02-26 and received the 임명장 that afternoon, so the end is that day. MOHW prints 1993-02-25 and ko.wikipedia 1993-02-25. Gender from the 1991-05-27 profiles, which name his wife. Birth date from the MOHW 약력 (solar). [verifier 2026-09-27] End disputed (1993-02-26 kept, 1993-02-25 alternative from 중앙일보 1993-02-25, see verification.disputes). 세계일보 1993-02-25 has him still in office on 24 Feb.

spells.transcript_notes: Spell predates the transcript coverage (2000-06 to 2025-01), so no check applies.
spells.notes: Named in the first 김영삼 cabinet on the morning of 1993-02-26 and given the 임명장 that afternoon. Former 한국여자의사회 회장. Resigned after reports of property speculation. She told 비서실장 박관용 on the afternoon of 1993-03-07 that she would step down (동아일보 1993-03-08), and the President accepted the resignation and appointed 송정숙 on the afternoon of 1993-03-08 (세계일보 1993-03-09 '이날짜로 수리', 조선일보 and 경향신문 1993-03-09). The 동아일보 1993-03-08 p.3 photo caption says the resignations were accepted on the 7th, against the other reports. The end is the acceptance day, a same-day handover. MOHW prints 1993-03-07 (day-before convention). ko.wikipedia prints 1993-02-25 as the start, one day before every other source. Birth year only because the MOHW 약력 gives a lunar date (1935/03/29 음력). Gender from the MOHW 약력 (경기여자고등학교, 한국여의사회 회장) and 국민일보 1993-02-26 (three women in the cabinet).

spells.notes: Continuation of the 보건사회부 spell across the renaming of 1994-12-23. 부칙 제2조① of 법률 제4831호 moves the 보건사회부장관's duties to the 보건복지부장관 and deems 보건사회부 officials to be 보건복지부 officials without the 정무직 exclusion it applies to 경제기획원, 재무부, 건설부 and 교통부, so the legal carry-over runs from 1994-12-23. 중앙일보 1994-12-24 already calls him 보건복지부장관 for a visit on 1994-12-23. The 12·23 개각 announced on the afternoon of 1994-12-23 named him to the new office. 동아일보, 경향신문 and 서울신문 1994-12-24 list him among the ministers appointed ('초대 보건복지부장관에 서상목보사부장관', '기용됐다'), which is why reappointed_on_reorg is true. 국민일보, 매일경제, 조선일보 and 한국일보 1994-12-24 call the same decision a 유임. All 국무위원 had handed in blanket resignations before the reshuffle (동아일보 1994-12-24). No report was found that he received a new 임명장 at the ceremony of the morning of 1994-12-24. See issues. Resigned over the 한약 dispute before PM 이홍구's visit to China, and 김영삼 accepted the resignation and named 이성호 on the afternoon of 1995-05-15 (한겨레, 세계일보, 서울신문 1995-05-16). MOHW prints 1995-05-15 and ko.wikipedia 1995-05-15. [verifier 2026-09-27] reappointed_on_reorg disputed (true kept). Besides the builder's sources, 동아일보 1994-12-24 p.5, 경향신문 1994-12-24 p.4 and 1994-12-25 p.3 and 동아일보 1994-12-25 p.4 call it a 유임, while 한겨레, 전자신문, 세계일보 and 전북일보 1994-12-24 list him among the 12·23 appointments. See verification.disputes. 매일경제 1994-12-28 p.40 has him acting as 보건복지부장관 on 1994-12-27.

spells.transcript_notes: Spell predates the transcript coverage (2000-06 to 2025-01), so no check applies.
spells.notes: Named on the afternoon of 1995-05-15 after PM 이홍구 returned from China, 임명장 on the morning of 1995-05-16 (동아일보 1995-05-17, 중도일보 1995-05-17). The 대통령기록관 schedule and the 대한민국사연표 date the appointment 1995-05-15 (announcement). Replaced in the 12·20 개각 of 1995, announced on 1995-12-20, with the successor's 임명장 on the morning of 1995-12-21. No separate date for his own 면직 was found, so the end is the successor's start. He returned to the same office on 1996-08-09 (later spell). MOHW prints 1995-12-20. Birth year only because the MOHW 약력 gives a lunar date (1938/12/18 음력), while na_members_12_22.csv prints 1938-12-18 as a full date. Gender from na_members_12_22.csv. [verifier 2026-09-27] end_reason corrected from replaced to resigned_to_run. 매일경제 1995-12-20 p.2 ('15대총선 출마를 위해 물러난다'), 조선일보 1995-12-20 p.7 ('총선출마때문에 처음부터 경질대상'), 동아일보 1995-12-20 p.5, 세계일보 1995-12-20 and 서울신문 1995-12-22 report that he left the cabinet to run in the 15th general election, which he won (경기 남양주시). The end stays on the successor's 임명장 day. No dated 이임식 was found (see verification.cross_lineage_notes).

Named in the 8·8 개각 of 1996, announced on the afternoon of 1996-08-08, and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1996-08-09, followed by his 취임식 at the ministry that morning (매일신문, 부산일보 1996-08-09, 매일경제 1996-08-10). spells.notes: Named on the morning of 1996-11-13 and given the 임명장 that afternoon (서울신문 1996-11-14). Kept on in the 12·20 개각 of 1996 (동아일보 1996-12-21) and the 3·5 개각 of 1997 (서울경제 1997-03-06 '유임된 ... 손학규 보건복지장관'). Replaced in the 8·5 개각 of 1997, which removed ministers holding 신한국당 membership before the presidential election. It was announced on the afternoon of 1997-08-05, and the successor received the 임명장 at 09:30 on 1997-08-06 (서울신문 1997-08-07, 한겨레 1997-08-07). No separate date for his own 면직 was found, so the end is the successor's start, the date the main file uses for 최광. MOHW prints 1997-08-05 and ko.wikipedia 1997-08-05. The MOHW 약력 line '1996/11/13 - 1997/03 보건복지부 장관' contradicts the list and the press and was not used. Birth year only because the MOHW 약력 gives a lunar date (1947/11/22 음력), while na_members_12_22.csv prints 1947-11-22. Gender from na_members_12_22.csv.

spells.notes: Kim Young-sam appointee in office on 1998-02-25 (caretaker). The reshuffle was announced 1997-08-05 (한국일보 1997-08-06) and MOHW lists 1997-08-06 as the start. 한겨레 1998-02-27 reports the 법제처 view that incumbent ministers stay until successors are appointed, and 보건복지부 continued under 법률 제5529호. His successor 주양자 was appointed 1998-03-03. MOHW lists his end as 1998-03-02 (its day-before convention).

issues.desc: Renaming of 1994-12-23. 서상목 is split into a 보건사회부 spell ending 1994-12-22 (end_reason ministry_reorganized) and a 보건복지부 spell from 1994-12-23 with reorg_continuation true, as ko.wikipedia does (MOHW merges them into one row). Unlike the merged ministries, 부칙 제2조① of 법률 제4831호 carries 보건사회부 officials over without a 정무직 exclusion, so the office passed to him by law on 1994-12-23, and 중앙일보 1994-12-24 calls him 보건복지부장관 for a visit on the 23rd. reappointed_on_reorg is set true because 동아일보, 경향신문 and 서울신문 1994-12-24 list him among the ministers appointed in the 12·23 개각. 국민일보, 매일경제, 조선일보 and 한국일보 of the same day call it a 유임, and no report was found that he received a new 임명장 at the ceremony of 1994-12-24. If the builder counts only new 임명장, reappointed_on_reorg should be false. The sibling environment lineage treats 박윤흔 (환경처 to 환경부, same 부칙 wording) as a legal continuation from 1994-12-23 as well.

Announcement day against 임명장 day. In eight changes the press reported the appointment on one day and the 임명장 on the next (1985-02-18/19, 1990-03-17/19, 1991-05-26/27, 1993-12-21/22, 1995-05-15/16, 1995-12-20/21, 1996-08-08/09, 1997-08-05/06). Starts here follow the 임명장 day, which the MOHW list also prints except for 이성호's second spell. nomination_date is the announcement day and outcome_date the 임명장 day. Where no separate exit date was found, the outgoing holder ends on the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor).

이성호's second start. MOHW, ko.wikipedia, the 대통령기록관 schedule ('1996-08-08 초대 해양수산부 장관 임명') and the 대한민국사연표 (tcct_1996_08_08_0010) give 1996-08-08, the announcement day. The 임명장 and his 취임식 were on the morning of 1996-08-09 (매일신문, 부산일보 1996-08-09, 매일경제 1996-08-10). This file uses 1996-08-09 (medium), as the finance and oceans ext88 files do for 한승수 and 신상우 in the same reshuffle. The science ext88 file keeps 1996-08-08 for 구본영. 조선일보 1996-08-08 notes that the legal appointment of a new minister is the President's signature on the papers, which may precede the 임명장. If 1996-08-08 is preferred, 김양배's end moves with it.

MOHW list end dates are the day before the successor's start for every replaced holder in the window. This file ends each holder on the dated resignation acceptance where one was reported (박양실 1993-03-08, 서상목 1995-05-15, 이성호 1996-11-13), on the day the outgoing minister is known to have been removed that same day (이해원 1988-02-25, 권이혁 1988-12-05, 문태준 1989-07-19), and on the successor's start otherwise.

Two News Library items disagree with the rest on a day. 동아일보 1989-07-19 p.3 says the 임명장 of the 7·19 개각 were given on the morning of the 18th, while the same paper's p.1 and 중앙일보, 한국일보 and 한겨레 say the 19th. 동아일보 1993-03-08 p.3 says the resignations of 박희태 and 박양실 were accepted on the 7th, while 세계일보 1993-03-09 says they were accepted that day (the 8th). Both were treated as errors.

The MOHW 약력 of 손학규 reads '1996/11/13 - 1997/03 보건복지부 장관', while the MOHW list, ko.wikipedia and the press put his exit in the 8·5 개각 of 1997 (서울경제 1997-03-06 lists him as retained on 1997-03-05). The 약력 line was not used.

Birth dates. The MOHW 약력 marks the dates of 권이혁, 김정수, 박양실, 송정숙, 이성호, 김양배 and 손학규 as lunar (음력), so only the year is given, as the main health file does for 주양자 and 최선정. na_members_12_22.csv prints the lunar dates of 김정수, 이성호, 김양배 and 손학규 as full dates. Solar dates are given for 이해원, 문태준, 김종인, 안필준 and 서상목. Gender comes from na_members_12_22.csv, from profiles that name the minister's wife (이해원, 권이혁, 문태준, 안필준), or from reports that call the minister a woman (박양실, 송정숙).

News Library OCR text was not compared with the scanned page images. Each date that rests on a News Library story is also supported by a BigKinds text from a different paper, the MOHW list, or the 대통령기록관 schedule. From 1990 동아일보, 경향신문 and 한겨레 are in both archives, and those pairs were not counted as independent.

[verifier 2026-09-27] 서상목 (보건복지부) reappointed_on_reorg true kept, with false as the alternative. In support of true, the announced 12·23 cabinet list names him to the new office apart from the retained ministers. 한겨레 1994-12-24 (BigKinds 01101001.19941224000000101) lists 보건복지부 among the posts filled ('발탁') and names only 교육, 농림수산 and 공보처 as 유임. 전자신문 1994-12-24 (BigKinds 07100501.19941224230036002) has him among those '각각 임명됐으며' with only 오인환 유임. 세계일보 1994-12-24 has '기용했다', and 전북일보 1994-12-24 prints him in the cabinet list. In support of false, 부칙 제2조① of 법률 제4831호 carries 보건사회부 officials over without a 정무직 exclusion, so no new appointment was legally needed. 동아일보 1994-12-24 p.5, 경향신문 1994-12-24 p.4, 경향신문 1994-12-25 p.3 and 동아일보 1994-12-25 p.4 (News Library, none cited by the builder), 헤럴드경제 1994-12-24 and the builder's 국민일보, 매일경제, 조선일보 and 한국일보 call it a 유임. 한겨레 counts 18 of 22 ministries changed while naming three 유임, which leaves 보건복지부 as the fourth unchanged one. 매일경제 1994-12-24 p.12 implies that only retained ministers were free on 24 Dec, the day of the 임명장 ceremony. No report says whether he received a new 임명장 on 1994-12-24. The 유임 wording does not settle it, because 전자신문 calls 홍재형 유임 too, and finance.ext88.verified.json found his new 임명장 of 1994-12-24. The main health file sets reappointed_on_reorg false for 전재희 at the 2010-03-19 renaming because no new appointment was found. Under that rule this spell would be false.

[verifier 2026-09-27] 안필준 (보건사회부) end 1993-02-26 kept, with 1993-02-25 as the alternative. In support of 26 Feb, 세계일보 1993-02-25 (BigKinds 01100701.19930225000000201) reports that the sitting 국무위원 would hold their 이취임식 on 26 Feb once the new cabinet was formed, and has 안필준 still 보사부장관 on 24 Feb. 동아일보 1993-02-26 p.3 (News Library 1993022600209203001) and 서울신문 1993-02-27 (BigKinds 01100611.20160421220544125) report other outgoing ministers' 이임식 on the morning of 26 Feb. The new cabinet received its 임명장 on the afternoon of 26 Feb (event E07). In support of 25 Feb, 중앙일보 1993-02-25 '내일 조각발표' (BigKinds 01100901.19930225151908002) says '현승종국무총리 등 이임정부의 각료들은 25일 일괄사표를 제출,전원 수리됐다.' No source dates 안필준's own exit. All 23 other lineages with a 노태우 minister end that spell on 1993-02-26 (environment.ext88.verified.json lists the verifiers' statuses). A single project rule for the 1993 transition is a researcher decision.

continuity.note: Every day of the window is covered. Handovers are same-day except two pairs on adjacent days with no empty day, the 1994-12-22/23 renaming (서상목 in both spells) and the 1995-05-15/16 change (서상목's resignation accepted on the afternoon of 05-15, 이성호's 임명장 on the morning of 05-16). There is no vacancy, so no acting head records. The MOHW list prints each replaced holder's end as the day before the successor's start. The retention checks confirm that the holder stayed through the reshuffles that did not touch this office.
